detail.body:
## Summary

Adds `allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B` (revision `a81bae42db39`) to Primus. Primer, an agent that onboards models to Primus, generated this change from candidate `454228eca573` (originating run `Olmo-3-1025-7B-20261015-011252-7710`; supporting runs none) and verified it on `main` at `0f996490ad1b`. It is a draft for maintainer review.

## Changes

| file | status | + | - |
|---|---|--:|--:|
| `examples/megatron/configs/MI300X/olmo_3_1025_7B-BF16-pretrain.yaml` | added | 69 | 0 |
| `examples/megatron/configs/MI325X/olmo_3_1025_7B-BF16-pretrain.yaml` | added | 69 | 0 |

| `primus/backends/megatron/checkpoint/native_loader_olmo3.py` | added | 331 | 0 |
| `primus/backends/megatron/core/models/olmo3/__init__.py` | added | 25 | 0 |
| `primus/backends/megatron/core/models/olmo3/olmo3_attention.py` | added | 78 | 0 |
| `primus/backends/megatron/core/models/olmo3/olmo3_builders.py` | added | 73 | 0 |
| `primus/backends/megatron/core/models/olmo3/olmo3_layer.py` | added | 88 | 0 |
| `primus/backends/megatron/core/models/olmo3/olmo3_layer_specs.py` | added | 55 | 0 |
| `primus/backends/megatron/core/models/olmo3/olmo3_transformer_config.py` | added | 73 | 0 |
| `primus/backends/megatron/megatron_pretrain_trainer.py` | modified | 8 | 0 |
| `primus/configs/models/megatron/olmo_3_1025_7B.yaml` | added | 41 | 0 |
| `primus/core/utils/import_utils.py` | modified | 13 | 2 |
| `runner/helpers/envs/base_env.sh` | modified | 7 | 0 |
| `tests/trainer/test_megatron_trainer.py` | modified | 9 | 0 |

15 files, +1008 -2.

## Testing

Primer's verification ladder in run `Olmo-3-1025-7B-20261015-011252-7710` (succeeded): L0, L1, L2, L3, L4 reached.

- **L0 Static:** The YAML the port adds loads the way Primus loads it: it parses, every extends target exists, override keys are known, and the new model has an experiment per platform and a trainer test entry.
- **L1 Layer math:** Each layer of the port against the reference implementation, through the Verifier's validated checks.
- **L2 Op parity on one GPU:** The kernels the port's layers run, at the model's shapes and settings, forward and backward against eager PyTorch, including ragged and tail shapes, warm allocator replay, guard zones and poisoned torch.empty: l2-op-parity on the op specs the Verifier writes and validates.
- **L3 Numeric parity:** The port's architecture matches the checkpoint's config, and the released weights loaded into the port give the same next-token log-probabilities as transformers.
- **L4 Training bar:** The port trains: the trainer test entry runs as written, and a short proxy run gives the same losses in two tensor-parallel layouts.

+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""
+Native, bridge-free HuggingFace -> Megatron-Core converter for OLMo-3 (``model_type: olmo3``,
+e.g. allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B).
+
+OLMo-3 is not a Llama layout, so it is built by Primus' own model code
+(``primus/backends/megatron/core/models/olmo3``, ``model_type: olmo3``):
+
+  * post-sublayer RMSNorms (``post_attention_layernorm``, ``post_feedforward_layernorm``) and no
+    input / pre-MLP norm, so the TE linears are plain (not layernorm-fused);
+  * ``q_norm`` / ``k_norm`` over the full projection width (all heads), held by
+    ``Olmo3SelfAttention.{q,k}_norm``;
+  * YaRN RoPE on every layer; sliding window on 3 of every 4 layers (no weights involved).
+
+Weight mapping (every HF tensor exactly once):
+
+  model.embed_tokens.weight                         -> embedding.word_embeddings.weight (vocab-padded)
+  lm_head.weight                                    -> output_layer.weight (vocab-padded)
+  model.norm.weight                                 -> decoder.final_layernorm.weight
+  model.layers.L.self_attn.{q,k,v}_proj.weight      -> decoder.layers.L.self_attention.linear_qkv.weight
+                                                       (interleaved per GQA group, no RoPE permutation)
+  model.layers.L.self_attn.o_proj.weight            -> decoder.layers.L.self_attention.linear_proj.weight
+  model.layers.L.self_attn.{q,k}_norm.weight        -> decoder.layers.L.self_attention.{q,k}_norm.weight
+  model.layers.L.post_attention_layernorm.weight    -> decoder.layers.L.post_attention_layernorm.weight
+  model.layers.L.post_feedforward_layernorm.weight  -> decoder.layers.L.post_feedforward_layernorm.weight
+  model.layers.L.mlp.{gate,up}_proj.weight          -> decoder.layers.L.mlp.linear_fc1.weight (concat)
+  model.layers.L.mlp.down_proj.weight               -> decoder.layers.L.mlp.linear_fc2.weight
+"""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.checkpoint import native_convert_common as common
+
+MODEL_TYPE = "olmo3"
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# HF config.json -> Megatron args
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def _rope_scaling(cfg):
+    rs = cfg.get("rope_scaling") or cfg.get("rope_parameters") or {}
+    if (rs.get("rope_type") or rs.get("type")) != "yarn":
+        return None
+    return rs
+
+
+def _window_skip_freq(cfg, num_layers):
+    """Megatron's window_attn_skip_freq from HF layer_types (1 = sliding, 0 = full)."""
+    types = cfg.get("layer_types")
+    if not types:
+        return None
+    pattern = [1 if t == "sliding_attention" else 0 for t in types][:num_layers]
+    # The regular OLMo-3 pattern (full every 4th layer) is the integer form, which also fits a reduced depth.
+    if all(v == (0 if (i + 1) % 4 == 0 else 1) for i, v in enumerate(pattern)):
+        return 4
+    return pattern
+
+
+def derive_megatron_fields(cfg):
+    """Translate an OLMo-3 HF config dict into Megatron arg values."""
+    num_heads = cfg["num_attention_heads"]
+    num_kv_heads = cfg.get("num_key_value_heads", num_heads)
+    rs = _rope_scaling(cfg)
+    fields = dict(
+        hidden_size=cfg["hidden_size"],
+        num_attention_heads=num_heads,
+        num_layers=cfg["num_hidden_layers"],
+        max_position_embeddings=cfg["max_position_embeddings"],
+        norm_epsilon=cfg.get("rms_norm_eps", 1e-6),
+        rotary_base=cfg.get("rope_theta", 10000.0),
+        untie_embeddings_and_output_weights=not cfg.get("tie_word_embeddings", False),
+        ffn_hidden_size=cfg["intermediate_size"],
+        num_query_groups=num_kv_heads,
+        kv_channels=cfg.get("head_dim") or cfg["hidden_size"] // num_heads,
+        add_qkv_bias=bool(cfg.get("attention_bias", False)),
+        sliding_window=cfg.get("sliding_window"),
+        layer_types=cfg.get("layer_types"),
+        yarn=None,
+    )
+    if rs is not None:
+        fields["yarn"] = dict(
+            factor=float(rs["factor"]),
+            original_max_position_embeddings=int(rs["original_max_position_embeddings"]),
+            beta_fast=float(rs.get("beta_fast", 32.0)),
+            beta_slow=float(rs.get("beta_slow", 1.0)),
+            attention_factor=rs.get("attention_factor"),
+            truncate=bool(rs.get("truncate", True)),
+        )
+    return fields
+
+
+def build_margs(cfg_fields, args):
+    import argparse
+
+    from megatron.training.arguments import add_megatron_arguments, validate_args
+
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(allow_abbrev=False)
+    p = add_megatron_arguments(p)
+    m = p.parse_args([])
+
+    m.model_type = MODEL_TYPE
+
+    # architecture / shapes
+    m.hidden_size = cfg_fields["hidden_size"]
+    m.num_attention_heads = cfg_fields["num_attention_heads"]
+    m.num_layers = cfg_fields["num_layers"]
+    # TransformerConfig's field is `layernorm_epsilon` (flag --norm-epsilon); `norm_epsilon` is inert for GPT.
+    m.layernorm_epsilon = cfg_fields["norm_epsilon"]
+    m.norm_epsilon = cfg_fields["norm_epsilon"]
+    m.ffn_hidden_size = cfg_fields["ffn_hidden_size"]
+    m.untie_embeddings_and_output_weights = cfg_fields["untie_embeddings_and_output_weights"]
+    m.max_position_embeddings = max(cfg_fields["max_position_embeddings"], args.seq_length)
+    m.seq_length = args.seq_length
+
+    m.group_query_attention = True
+    m.num_query_groups = cfg_fields["num_query_groups"]
+    m.kv_channels = cfg_fields["kv_channels"]
+    # Full-width QK norm lives in Olmo3SelfAttention; Megatron's per-head qk_layernorm stays off.
+    m.qk_layernorm = False
+
+    m.normalization = "RMSNorm"
+    m.swiglu = True
+    m.add_bias_linear = False
+    m.add_qkv_bias = cfg_fields["add_qkv_bias"]
+    m.position_embedding_type = "rope"
+    m.rotary_base = cfg_fields["rotary_base"]
+    m.apply_rope_fusion = False
+
+    # YaRN (Olmo3TransformerConfig fields; the builder switches the rotary embedding to YaRN)
+    y = cfg_fields.get("yarn")
+    if y is not None:
+        m.yarn_rotary_scaling_factor = y["factor"]
+        m.yarn_original_max_position_embeddings = y["original_max_position_embeddings"]
+        m.yarn_beta_fast = y["beta_fast"]
+        m.yarn_beta_slow = y["beta_slow"]
+        m.yarn_mscale = None
+        m.yarn_mscale_all_dim = None
+        m.yarn_correction_range_round_to_int = y["truncate"]
+        if y.get("attention_factor") is not None:
+            import math
+
+            want = 0.1 * math.log(y["factor"]) + 1.0
+            assert (
+                abs(float(y["attention_factor"]) - want) < 1e-6
+            ), f"YaRN attention_factor {y['attention_factor']} != 0.1*ln(factor)+1 = {want}"
+
+    # Sliding window: window_size[0] in HF sliding_window units (Olmo3TransformerConfig converts for TE).
+    if cfg_fields.get("sliding_window"):
+        m.window_size = (int(cfg_fields["sliding_window"]), 0)
+        m.window_attn_skip_freq = _window_skip_freq(
+            {"layer_types": cfg_fields.get("layer_types")}, m.num_layers
+        )
+
+    m.num_experts = None
+
+    m.vocab_size = None
+    m.make_vocab_size_divisible_by = args.make_vocab_size_divisible_by
+    m.tokenizer_type = "HuggingFaceTokenizer"
+    m.tokenizer_model = args.hf_dir
+    m.trust_remote_code = False
+
+    m.micro_batch_size = 1
+    m.global_batch_size = 1
+    m.train_iters = 1
+
+    m.tensor_model_parallel_size = args.tensor_parallel_size
+    m.pipeline_model_parallel_size = args.pipeline_parallel_size
+    m.expert_model_parallel_size = args.expert_parallel_size
+    m.expert_tensor_parallel_size = args.tensor_parallel_size
+    m.context_parallel_size = 1
+    m.sequence_parallel = False
+    m.world_size = args.tensor_parallel_size * args.pipeline_parallel_size * args.expert_parallel_size
+    m.rank = 0
+    if args.dtype == "bf16":
+        m.bf16 = True
+        m.params_dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    elif args.dtype == "fp16":
+        m.fp16 = True
+        m.params_dtype = torch.float16
+    else:
+        m.params_dtype = torch.float32
+    m.use_cpu_initialization = True
+    m.perform_initialization = False
+    m.transformer_impl = "transformer_engine"
+    m.gradient_accumulation_fusion = False
+    m.async_tensor_model_parallel_allreduce = False
+    m.bias_gelu_fusion = False
+    m.bias_swiglu_fusion = False
+    m.masked_softmax_fusion = False
+    m.bias_dropout_fusion = False
+    m.apply_query_key_layer_scaling = False
+    m.attention_dropout = 0.0
+    m.hidden_dropout = 0.0
+
+    m.save = args.save_dir
+    m.ckpt_format = "torch"
+    m.no_save_optim = True
+    m.no_save_rng = True
+    m.no_load_optim = True
+    m.no_load_rng = True
+    m.save_interval = 1
+    m.async_save = False
+    m.ckpt_assume_constant_structure = False
+    m.iteration = 1
+
+    m = validate_args(m)
+    m.iteration = 1
+    return m
+
+
+def build_model(margs):
+    """The OLMo-3 model (Primus model code, ``model_type: olmo3``)."""
+    from primus.core.utils.import_utils import get_model_provider
+
+    model = get_model_provider(model_type=MODEL_TYPE)(pre_process=True, post_process=True)
+    return model.to(margs.params_dtype)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# HF -> mcore weight mapping
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def build_mcore_state_dict(model, store, margs, cfg_fields, log):
+    dtype = margs.params_dtype
+    padded_vocab = model.state_dict()["embedding.word_embeddings.weight"].shape[0]
+
+    nh = margs.num_attention_heads
+    ng = margs.num_query_groups
+    hdim = margs.kv_channels
+    hidden = margs.hidden_size
+    assert nh % ng == 0, f"num_heads ({nh}) must be divisible by num_query_groups ({ng})"
+
+    sd = {}
+    consumed = set()
+
+    def get(name):
+        assert name not in consumed, f"HF tensor {name} mapped twice"
+        consumed.add(name)
+        return store.get(name, dtype)
+
+    def fused_qkv(h):
+        q = get(h + "self_attn.q_proj.weight")
+        k = get(h + "self_attn.k_proj.weight")
+        v = get(h + "self_attn.v_proj.weight")
+        return torch.cat(
+            [
+                q.reshape(ng, (nh // ng) * hdim, hidden),
+                k.reshape(ng, hdim, hidden),
+                v.reshape(ng, hdim, hidden),
+            ],
+            dim=1,
+        ).reshape(-1, hidden)
+
+    sd["embedding.word_embeddings.weight"] = common.pad_vocab(get("model.embed_tokens.weight"), padded_vocab)
+    sd["decoder.final_layernorm.weight"] = get("model.norm.weight")
+    if margs.untie_embeddings_and_output_weights:
+        sd["output_layer.weight"] = common.pad_vocab(get("lm_head.weight"), padded_vocab)
+    elif store.has("lm_head.weight"):
+        consumed.add("lm_head.weight")
+
+    for L in range(margs.num_layers):
+        p = f"decoder.layers.{L}."
+        h = f"model.layers.{L}."
+        sd[p + "self_attention.linear_qkv.weight"] = fused_qkv(h)
+        # Full-width norms: [nh * hdim] in head order, the same order as the query heads above
+        # (with ng < nh the query heads stay in HF order: group g holds heads g*nh/ng ...).
+        sd[p + "self_attention.q_norm.weight"] = get(h + "self_attn.q_norm.weight")
+        sd[p + "self_attention.k_norm.weight"] = get(h + "self_attn.k_norm.weight")
+        sd[p + "self_attention.linear_proj.weight"] = get(h + "self_attn.o_proj.weight")
+        sd[p + "post_attention_layernorm.weight"] = get(h + "post_attention_layernorm.weight")
+        sd[p + "mlp.linear_fc1.weight"] = torch.cat(
+            [get(h + "mlp.gate_proj.weight"), get(h + "mlp.up_proj.weight")], dim=0
+        ).contiguous()
+        sd[p + "mlp.linear_fc2.weight"] = get(h + "mlp.down_proj.weight")
+        sd[p + "post_feedforward_layernorm.weight"] = get(h + "post_feedforward_layernorm.weight")
+        if L % 8 == 0 or L == margs.num_layers - 1:
+            log(f"  mapped layer {L:2d}")
+
+    return sd, consumed
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# In-process entrypoint
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def convert(
+    hf_dir,
+    save_dir,
+    *,
+    dtype="bf16",
+    tensor_parallel_size=1,
+    pipeline_parallel_size=1,
+    expert_parallel_size=1,
+    seq_length=4096,
+    make_vocab_size_divisible_by=128,
+    master_port=29563,
+    log=None,
+):
+    """Convert an OLMo-3 HF checkpoint to a legacy Megatron torch ckpt (single process, CPU)."""
+    if log is None:
+
+        def log(*a):
+            print("[olmo3-convert]", *a, flush=True)
+
+    common.ensure_megatron_on_path()
+    common.assert_bridge_free("entry")
+    args = SimpleNamespace(
+        hf_dir=hf_dir,
+        save_dir=save_dir,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        tensor_parallel_size=tensor_parallel_size,
+        pipeline_parallel_size=pipeline_parallel_size,
+        expert_parallel_size=expert_parallel_size,
+        seq_length=seq_length,
+        make_vocab_size_divisible_by=make_vocab_size_divisible_by,
+    )
+    cfg_fields = derive_megatron_fields(common.read_hf_config(hf_dir))
+    margs = build_margs(cfg_fields, args)
+    margs = common.init_megatron_single_process(margs, master_port, log=log)
+    common.assert_bridge_free("post-init")
+    model = build_model(margs)
+    store = common.SafetensorsStore(hf_dir)
+    sd, consumed = build_mcore_state_dict(model, store, margs, cfg_fields, log)
+    common.load_validate_save(model, sd, consumed, store, margs, save_dir, log)
+    common.assert_bridge_free("post-save")
+    return save_dir

+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""OLMo-3 self-attention: QK RMSNorm over the full projection width.
+
+HF ``Olmo3Attention`` applies ``q_norm = RMSNorm(num_heads * head_dim)`` to the
+whole ``q_proj`` output (and ``k_norm`` to ``k_proj``) before the head split and
+RoPE. The RMS statistic therefore spans every head. Under tensor parallelism
+each rank holds ``num_heads / tp`` heads, so the per-rank sum of squares is
+all-reduced over the TP group (autograd-aware) before normalising; the norm
+weight is sharded with the heads (``partition_dim=0``), so its gradient needs no
+TP reduction (unlike Megatron's per-head ``q_layernorm``, which is replicated).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.layers import set_tensor_model_parallel_attributes
+from megatron.core.transformer.attention import SelfAttention
+from megatron.core.transformer.module import MegatronModule
+from megatron.core.transformer.utils import make_sharded_tensors_for_checkpoint
+
+
+class Olmo3FullWidthRMSNorm(MegatronModule):
+    """RMSNorm over ``[..., heads, head_dim]`` jointly (all heads), TP-sharded along heads."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config, local_heads: int, head_dim: int, total_width: int, eps: float, tp_group):
+        super().__init__(config=config)
+        self.local_heads, self.head_dim, self.total_width, self.eps = local_heads, head_dim, total_width, eps
+        self.tp_group = tp_group
+        self.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(
+            torch.ones(
+                local_heads * head_dim,
+                dtype=config.params_dtype,
+                device="cpu" if config.use_cpu_initialization else torch.cuda.current_device(),
+            )
+        )
+        set_tensor_model_parallel_attributes(self.weight, is_parallel=True, dim=0, stride=1)
+        setattr(self.weight, "sequence_parallel", False)
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # x: [s, b, local_heads, head_dim]
+        x32 = x.float()
+        sumsq = x32.pow(2).sum(dim=(-2, -1), keepdim=True)
+        if self.tp_group is not None and self.tp_group.size() > 1:
+            sumsq = torch.distributed.nn.functional.all_reduce(sumsq, group=self.tp_group)
+        y = x32 * torch.rsqrt(sumsq / self.total_width + self.eps)
+        y = self.weight.float().view(self.local_heads, self.head_dim) * y
+        return y.to(x.dtype).contiguous()
+
+    def sharded_state_dict(self, prefix="", sharded_offsets=(), metadata=None):
+        state_dict = self.state_dict(prefix="", keep_vars=True)
+        return make_sharded_tensors_for_checkpoint(state_dict, prefix, {"weight": 0}, sharded_offsets)
+
+
+class Olmo3SelfAttention(SelfAttention):
+    """``SelfAttention`` with OLMo-3's full-width ``q_norm`` / ``k_norm``."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config, submodules, layer_number, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(config=config, submodules=submodules, layer_number=layer_number, **kwargs)
+        tp_group = self.pg_collection.tp
+        hd = self.hidden_size_per_attention_head
+        self.q_norm = Olmo3FullWidthRMSNorm(
+            config,
+            self.num_attention_heads_per_partition,
+            hd,
+            config.num_attention_heads * hd,
+            config.layernorm_epsilon,
+            tp_group,
+        )
+        self.k_norm = Olmo3FullWidthRMSNorm(
+            config,
+            self.num_query_groups_per_partition,
+            hd,
+            config.num_query_groups * hd,
+            config.layernorm_epsilon,
+            tp_group,
+        )
+
+    def get_query_key_value_tensors(
+        self, hidden_states, key_value_states=None, output_gate=False, split_qkv=True
+    ):
+        assert (
+            split_qkv and not output_gate
+        ), "OLMo-3 attention needs split q/k/v (no fused qkv-rope, no gate)"
+        assert (
+            self.config.num_query_groups >= self.world_size
+        ), "OLMo-3 full-width QK norm needs tp <= kv heads"
+        query, key, value = super().get_query_key_value_tensors(
+            hidden_states, key_value_states, output_gate=False, split_qkv=True
+        )
+        return self.q_norm(query), self.k_norm(key), value.contiguous()

+###############################################################################

+###############################################################################
+
+"""OLMo-3 decoder layer: norms after each sublayer (``h = x + norm(f(x))``)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_layer import TransformerLayer
+from megatron.core.utils import make_viewless_tensor
+
+
+class Olmo3TransformerLayer(TransformerLayer):
+    """``TransformerLayer`` with OLMo-3's post-sublayer RMSNorms.
+
+    The spec leaves ``input_layernorm`` / ``pre_mlp_layernorm`` as ``IdentityOp``;
+    this class adds ``post_attention_layernorm`` and ``post_feedforward_layernorm``
+    (built with ``post_norm``, e.g. ``TENorm``) and applies them to the sublayer
+    output before the residual add.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, config, submodules, layer_number=1, hidden_dropout=None, post_norm=None, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(
+            config=config,
+            submodules=submodules,
+            layer_number=layer_number,
+            hidden_dropout=hidden_dropout,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+        assert post_norm is not None, "Olmo3TransformerLayer needs a post_norm builder"
+        self.post_attention_layernorm = post_norm(
+            config=self.config, hidden_size=self.config.hidden_size, eps=self.config.layernorm_epsilon
+        )
+        self.post_feedforward_layernorm = post_norm(
+            config=self.config, hidden_size=self.config.hidden_size, eps=self.config.layernorm_epsilon
+        )
+
+    def _dropout_add(self, out_with_bias, residual):
+        out, bias = out_with_bias
+        assert bias is None, "OLMo-3 linears are bias-free"
+        return out, residual
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states,
+        attention_mask=None,
+        context=None,
+        context_mask=None,
+        rotary_pos_emb=None,
+        rotary_pos_cos=None,
+        rotary_pos_sin=None,
+        rotary_pos_cos_sin=None,
+        attention_bias=None,
+        inference_context=None,
+        packed_seq_params=None,
+        sequence_len_offset=None,
+        padding_mask=None,
+        *,
+        inference_params=None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ):
+        import torch
+
+        if inference_context is None:
+            inference_context = inference_params
+        residual = hidden_states
+        attn_out, attn_bias = self.self_attention(
+            hidden_states,
+            attention_mask=attention_mask,
+            inference_context=inference_context,
+            rotary_pos_emb=rotary_pos_emb,
+            rotary_pos_cos=rotary_pos_cos,
+            rotary_pos_sin=rotary_pos_sin,
+            rotary_pos_cos_sin=rotary_pos_cos_sin,
+            attention_bias=attention_bias,
+            packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params,
+            sequence_len_offset=sequence_len_offset,
+        )
+        assert attn_bias is None, "OLMo-3 attention output projection is bias-free"
+        attn_out = self.post_attention_layernorm(attn_out)
+        attn_out = torch.nn.functional.dropout(attn_out, p=self.hidden_dropout, training=self.training)
+        hidden_states = residual + attn_out
+
+        residual = hidden_states
+        mlp_out, mlp_bias = self.mlp(hidden_states)
+        assert mlp_bias is None, "OLMo-3 MLP is bias-free"
+        mlp_out = self.post_feedforward_layernorm(mlp_out)
+        mlp_out = torch.nn.functional.dropout(mlp_out, p=self.hidden_dropout, training=self.training)
+        output = residual + mlp_out
+        output = make_viewless_tensor(inp=output, requires_grad=output.requires_grad, keep_graph=True)
+        return output, context

+"""OLMo-3 transformer config: the YaRN fields and the sliding-window convention."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+
+__all__ = ["Olmo3TransformerConfig"]
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Olmo3TransformerConfig(TransformerConfig):
+    """Config for the OLMo-3 dense decoder.
+
+    YaRN: when ``yarn_rotary_scaling_factor`` is set, the model builds Megatron's
+    ``YarnRotaryEmbedding`` (``position_embedding_type='yarn'``) from these fields.
+    ``yarn_mscale``/``yarn_mscale_all_dim`` left at None give the HF default
+    attention factor ``0.1 * ln(factor) + 1`` (1.2079 for factor 8), which
+    Megatron multiplies into cos/sin, as HF does.
+
+    Sliding window: ``window_size[0]`` is given in Hugging Face ``sliding_window``
+    units (the number of keys a query sees, itself included: HF masks
+    ``kv_idx > q_idx - sliding_window``). Transformer Engine's left window does
+    not count the query itself, so it is converted to ``(sliding_window - 1, 0)``
+    here. ``window_attn_skip_freq: 4`` keeps every fourth layer (1-indexed
+    4, 8, ...; HF ``full_attention``) global.
+    """
+
+    # 1.0 = no YaRN. Megatron's attention reads this field (if present) for the cos/sin mscale.
+    yarn_rotary_scaling_factor: float = 1.0
+    yarn_original_max_position_embeddings: int = 4096
+    yarn_beta_fast: float = 32.0
+    yarn_beta_slow: float = 1.0
+    yarn_mscale: Optional[float] = None
+    yarn_mscale_all_dim: Optional[float] = None
+    yarn_correction_range_round_to_int: bool = True
+
+    # GPTModel prefers config.position_embedding_type; __post_init__ sets 'yarn' when YaRN is on
+    # (args keep 'rope': Megatron's CLI has no 'yarn' choice for non-MLA models).
+    position_embedding_type: str = "rope"
+
+    # window_size[0] is in HF sliding_window units (see the docstring).
+    olmo3_window_size_hf_units: bool = True
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        if self.window_size is not None:
+            left, right = (int(x) for x in self.window_size)
+            if self.olmo3_window_size_hf_units and left > 0:
+                left -= 1
+                self.olmo3_window_size_hf_units = False  # converted once (configs get re-built/copied)
+            self.window_size = (left, right)
+        super().__post_init__()
+        if self.use_yarn:
+            self.position_embedding_type = "yarn"
+            # mscale != 1 is not supported by TE's fused RoPE (Megatron falls back anyway).
+            self.apply_rope_fusion = False
+        assert not self.multi_latent_attention, "OLMo-3 uses its own attention, not MLA."
+        assert not self.qk_layernorm, (
+            "OLMo-3 uses a full-width QK norm built by its own attention; keep qk_layernorm false "
+            "(per-head q/k_layernorm would be a different model)."
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def use_yarn(self) -> bool:
+        return float(self.yarn_rotary_scaling_factor) > 1.0

+# Differences from Llama-3 that this preset selects (built by primus/backends/megatron/core/models/olmo3):
+#   * model_type olmo3: post-sublayer RMSNorms (no input / pre-MLP norm) and QK RMSNorm over the
+#     full projection width (all heads); keep qk_layernorm false (that is Megatron's per-head norm).
+#   * YaRN RoPE on every layer (factor 8, original 8192, beta_fast 32, beta_slow 1,
+#     attention factor 0.1*ln(8)+1); position_embedding_type stays `rope` for Megatron's CLI.
+#   * sliding window 4096 keys (HF units; the model converts to TE's (4095, 0)) on 3 of every
+#     4 layers; window_attn_skip_freq 4 keeps 1-indexed layers 4, 8, ... global.
+extends:
+  - llama3_base.yaml
+
+model_type: olmo3
+

+

+

issue_comments.body:
Two commits on top of the one Primer generated:

- `47661d49` merges `main`. The only conflict was in `primus/core/utils/import_utils.py`, where #1199 added ZAYA1 at the same place; both model types are kept.
- `26b6445c` is formatting only: isort and black from this repo's pre-commit hooks, on five of the new files. `pre-commit run --all-files` passes.

The first commit, `6c50edd3`, is the tree Primer verified on `0f996490ad1b` (L0 to L4 above).

For review: after the merge, `runner/helpers/envs/base_env.sh` runs #1237's "keep a preset HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES", then this PR's block that sets `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` to `HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES` when the two differ. If a scheduler sets only `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`, the block replaces that selection with the default `0..GPUS_PER_NODE-1`, which #1237 avoids. The block isn't Olmo-specific, so it may be better dropped from this PR or reworked to take the scheduler's selection.
